reason: V1 exposed a one-sided median-pool boundary error at cz_min. V2 uses a wider median pool and entirely fresh validation seeds.

algorithm.reference: Hoffman et al. 2021, MNRAS 505, 3380, equations 23 and 36
algorithm.selection_rule: Minimize development mean over seeds of abs(z_mean) + abs(z_std - 1) + max_abs_radial_bias_in_sigma; ties choose the larger window.

mock.catalog_sampling: Use the actual grouped-CF4 cz and e_DM distributions in the median pool; do not use observed peculiar velocities.

acceptance.policy: All gates must pass before BGc can be wired into the N64 CF4 CR comparison. This does not validate rows below cz_min.

result.scope: Authorized for an N64 CF4 CR comparison only in 1500 <= cz <= 18000 km/s; nearby rows remain excluded pending a hierarchical likelihood
